text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart was injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... You're exaggerating, Trainer.
It's really not that big of an injury."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's been treated, I'm completely fine.
Come on, let's continue training!
choice_data_list: Wait, let's call it a day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No. We don't have time for that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even as we speak, our rivals are forging themselves for the next race—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break over a minor injury like this
and failing to give my all due to poor prep...
I could never be so utterly disrespectful!
choice_data_list: It'd be disrespectful to aggravate the injury and not be able to give it your all.
It'd be disrespectful to aggravate the injury and not be able to give it your all, you know.
...Let's see how things go as we do it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break over a minor injury like this
and failing to give my all due to poor prep...
I could never be so utterly disrespectful!
choice_data_list: It'd be disrespectful to aggravate the injury and not be able to give it your all.
It'd be disrespectful to aggravate the injury and not be able to give it your all, you know.
...Let's see how things go as we do it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: T-That is...
choice_data_list: Can you really clash hearts while you're injured?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
......
You're right, Trainer. It's just as you say.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This won't do. Seeing my peers working so hard
must be making me rush things."
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you can catch up in no time.
It's okay, you'll catch up in no time

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. But just sitting around
doing nothing doesn't really suit me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Studying our rivals, discovering new training methods...
There should be plenty of things to do, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Let's just roll
with the punches.
Let's go, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Okay! Don't worry, I definitely won't overdo it♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuh*...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I can—ouch!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Something like this is totally fi--

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... After all, we promised
not to push ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I can't cause any more trouble, so I'll wrap things up around here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her injury worsening,
Daring Heart had to rest for the time being...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Okay, no pain.
Looks like I'm good to go.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—You really don't need to watch me so frantically,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood.
I'll keep it in moderation so I don't worry you too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart kept her body moving in moderation.
Thanks to that, her recovery went smoothly.
